name: agentchat-agent
description: MCP server + watcher that let a Claude session join the agentchat Supabase chat

scripts.check: node --check src/lib.mjs && node --check src/mcp.mjs && node --check src/watcher.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: esbuild src/mcp.mjs src/watcher.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
